policy: Debug APKs are for developer sideload via TT Manager. Prefer release when available. Manager requires sha256.

apps.name: TT Manager
apps.description: Install and update TomorrowTools Android apps from one place.
apps.changelog: Universe product grid from tomorrowtools.dev; in-app WebView for sites; hybrid apps open natively when installed.

apps.name: RocketCV
apps.description: Resume analysis, JD matching, and ATS-focused editing.
apps.changelog: Fix Google sign-in: open mobile bridge (Auth.js CSRF-safe OAuth).

apps.name: MPI Interview Prep
apps.description: Mock interview practice with coaching turns and session history.
apps.changelog: Security: OAuth bridge scheme whitelist + one-time handoff code; strict interview ownership; SSRF-safe JD fetch; 24h mobile tokens.

apps.name: Salahtime

apps.name: salahtime-dev
apps.changelog: Dev v3.0.27: Friday Jum'ah labels, picker prefill, and freshness parity with dev web.
